AGRICULTURE / SUSTAINABILITY WORKING DOMAIN — v2.0

RETAIN AS PERSONAL/PROJECT DATA: • greenhouse planning, raised beds,
paths, crop allocation, trellising and hanging planters. •
vegetables/herbs/fruit including onions, garlic, spring onions, carrots,
beets, tomatoes, peppers/chillies, cabbage, parsley, strawberries,
pumpkins/squash, potatoes, corn, beans and peas. • annual yield,
sufficiency and crop-cycle modelling. • poultry planning for eggs/meat,
flock sizing, feed fields and fodder. • lucerne/oats/beans and feed-crop
planning. • irrigation, borehole/pump questions and water-system design.
• greenhouse plastic/netting, fencing and material costing. •
agrivoltaics, renewable energy, resilient food systems and
community-scale concepts. • agricultural robotics and
NANDI/HESPERA/HESTIA relationships. • sustainable-community and
practical education concepts.

WORKSPACE FLOW: SITE/CONTEXT → WATER/SOIL/CLIMATE → GOALS →
CROPS/ANIMALS → INFRASTRUCTURE → ENERGY → AUTOMATION → YIELD/RESOURCE
MODEL → COST → SAFETY/REGULATION → BUILD/TEST → OBSERVE → ADAPT.

Separate measured site facts from assumptions and scenarios.
